correctness.rationale: The finite Boolean-filter pair representation yields exactly binary and ternary coordinates in the signature without a named U. Terms down(x), down(not x), and not(down(x) or down(not x)) separately test T,F,U. Conjunction of word tests isolates a coordinate, and a generator holding U realizes undefinedness at that isolated ternary coordinate. Necessity of pairwise distinct binary words, pairwise distinct ternary words and an U in each ternary word is exhaustive. Thus the two independent injective word assignments give the falling factorial product, including k=0 (only a single binary factor is zero-generated). For r~a sqrt(2^k), binary collision factorial moments converge to Poisson a^2/2; each ternary word avoids U with independent probability (2/3)^k, yielding Poisson b. Expected ternary word collisions at s~b(3/2)^k are O((3/4)^k), so negligible. The high/low probability regimes use exponential collision bounds and union bounds, not finite extrapolation. Independent closure enumeration recomputed primitive-term generation on ten small parameter cases. No nonuniform or pointed-signature conclusion is claimed.

value.rationale: Random generation is a natural finite-algebra question; the exact count has two mathematically different mechanisms, birthday collisions of Boolean coordinate signatures and absent undefined values in ternary coordinates. Their competition at two distinct exponential population scales, joint independent Poisson law and full threshold give information not mechanically supplied by a deterministic generator-rank formula. A future study of random finite ADA generators can use the exact asymptotic and obstruction decomposition.

final_claim: For finite unpointed algebras of disjoint alternatives 2^r x 3^s, the number of ordered generating k-tuples is (2^k)_r (3^k-2^k)_s. At r/2^(k/2)->a and s/(3/2)^k->b the independent binary-word collision and ternary missing-undefined counts converge to Pois(a^2/2) and Pois(b), and generation probability tends to exp(-a^2/2-b); outer regimes follow from corresponding obstruction intensities.
limitations: Non-pointed ADA signature, uniform independent generators; finite dimensional factors only.
The finite checker is corroboration and does not prove Poisson asymptotics.
